title: Game Changing Modpack
description: This modpack adds a bunch of new biomes, 4 new dimensions, guns, & so much more!
body:
# About This Modpack

Looking for a fresh Minecraft experience? This modpack completely transforms the game with over **140 carefully selected mods**, bringing new adventures, dimensions, technology, combat, and quality-of-life improvements while still feeling like Minecraft. And that’s only the beginning—this modpack adds so much more to discover as you play.

## What You'll Find

🌎 **Explore 4 New Dimensions**

* **Blue Skies** introduces **Everbright** and **Everdawn**, two beautiful dimensions filled with unique biomes, dungeons, bosses, mobs, and loot.
* **The Aether** lets you explore floating islands high above the clouds with new enemies, equipment, and challenges.
* **Twilight Forest** offers a progression-based adventure packed with massive dungeons, powerful bosses, and hidden secrets.

⚙️ **Engineer Anything**
Create incredible machines, automated farms, factories, trains, and more with the **Create** mod.

🔫 **Upgrade Your Combat**
Fight with realistic firearms from **Timeless and Classics Zero (TaCZ)** while exploring dangerous structures and battling powerful enemies. You can also gear up with **copper armor** and **stone armor**, giving early-game progression more variety and making survival feel more rewarding. And if you want something more flashy than diamond armor, I've added **emerald armor and tools**! On top of that, **First Aid** makes combat even more intense by changing how health works, so every fight feels more dangerous and every injury matters.

🌾 **Expand Survival**
Enjoy a richer survival experience with **Farmer's Delight**, **Butchery**, new foods, cooking mechanics, backpacks, and many useful quality-of-life features. **Tough As Nails** also makes survival more challenging by adding thirst and temperature, so you’ll need to stay prepared while exploring, traveling, and surviving in harsher environments.

🦌 **Experience a More Alive World**
The **Naturalist** mod adds realistic wildlife and more animals to the world, making forests, rivers, and other biomes feel much more natural and immersive. You’ll also find **Ribbits**, which adds swamp villages and makes swampy areas feel much more alive and interesting to explore.

🏡 **Build Better**
Decorate your world with furniture, improved bridges, better structures, new building blocks, and plenty of decorative options.

👹 **Expect the Unexpected**
The caves aren't as safe anymore... horror elements and dangerous mobs make exploring underground much more intense.

✨ **A More Immersive World**
Experience better player models, first-person body rendering, dynamic lighting with flashlights, improved visuals, and **multiple shader options** so you can choose the look that fits your style best. The **Camerapture** mod also lets you take in-game photos, making it easy to capture your favorite builds, adventures, and memories from the world.

🚀 **Performance Optimized**
Despite the large amount of content, the modpack includes numerous optimization mods to help keep gameplay running smoothly.

## This modpack also adds so much more!

This modpack adds even more than the things I mentioned above, so there’s always something new to find and have fun exploring!

## Before You Play

Some mods use the same default keybinds, so you'll need to change a few controls after installing. It only takes a few minutes, and once that's done, everything should work perfectly.

## Twilight Forest

Twilight Forest is **not included** because the compatible version wasn't available on Modrinth when this modpack was created. I've already selected the correct Minecraft version and mod loader, so simply download the compatible version from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest/files/5468648) and drop it into your mods folder.

## Performance

This is a large modpack with over **140 mods**, so a decent gaming PC is recommended.

For reference, I use an **RTX 3060**, and the game runs well during normal gameplay. If I'm in a Discord call, my FPS drops to around 30, so performance will depend on whether you're on a call or doing something similar.

## Updates

I'll do my best to keep the modpack updated whenever major mods receive new versions. Updates may take a little time if I'm busy, but I'll release them as soon as I can.

## Questions, Suggestions, or Bugs?

Found a bug? Have an idea? Just want to chat?

Feel free to join my [Discord](https://discord.gg/fV7yqu3pW) server! I'd love to hear your feedback and make the modpack even better.
